lede: Student verification and fair pricing context: Alive Verify API handshake concept, and the practical reason JVTO uses it.

items.body: ISIC is positioned as a globally recognized proof of student status. For youth travel and budget-sensitive travelers, it acts as a legitimacy and fairness signal.

items.title: Alive Verify API (as described)
items.body: When a student enters their card number, the system performs a real-time “handshake” with the global ISIC database to validate active status.

sections.title: Why it matters in the Why JVTO ecosystem

items.title: Fair pricing, structurally enforced
items.body: Student pricing is not treated as a vague promise. It is structured around verification.

items.title: Digital maturity signal
items.body: Implementing verification via API is positioned as a differentiator versus fully manual operators.
